label: PROVEN_PLAYER
refinement: Full SVT-AV1 inside a 448-byte Groth16 is not a real circuit. The receipt binds hashes of the ingest, the AV1 container, and a 4096-byte slice Merkle root.
SVT-AV1 Encoder Lib v1.7.0 encoded three 1-second 160x90 AV1 MP4 chunks on CPU (preset 10, CRF 40). Demo chunks are shorter than the 5-second protocol target so the leader sequence is visible.
ffmpeg reported libdav1d 1.4.1 while probing the containers. The browser player hands unlocked MP4 bytes to the video element, which uses dav1d on Chromium and Firefox.
An RTX A4500 is Ampere. Its NVENC block does not encode AV1. SVT-AV1 ran on CPU. CUDA is not part of this player.
Registry address, Base tx, and IPFS CID stay null. Availability until a real loc is sealed.
This player does not route through feed-player, kids-player, or token-player.
